svg.aria-label: Module Cost Across Workloads and Backward Precisions
svg.text: Module Cost Across Workloads and Backward Precisions
Points are medians of five trials; whiskers show min–max. Lines connect four measured sizes. The backward
selector changes miniTE CUTLASS/miniTE per-token; TE NVFP4/TE per-token retain their recorded recipes. ·
Select FC1/FC2, forward/direct F+B, miniTE backward precision, and the upstream reference. Points are
medians of five runs; whiskers show minima and maxima, not confidence intervals. Lines connect the four
measured pre-dispatch token scales. The default view shows FC1 direct F+B with MXFP8 backward for both
miniTE paths; FC2 is selectable. Figure 6 provides the forward/F+B overview.
